tasks.title: Define --adm-* tokens (light + dark) in admin/styles.css
acceptance_criteria: :root defines every --adm-* token with the current light values (bg, bg-deep, card, card-alt, ink, ink-soft, ink-faint, line, line-strong, accent, input-bg) plus a new --adm-cool (#4b6d9c).
:root[data-theme="dark"] overrides all of them with the dark palette from the spec table.
No existing rule in styles.css is broken; the file still only uses var(--adm-*).
Light values are identical to today so light mode is unchanged.
tests: admin/styles.css defines a :root[data-theme="dark"] block overriding --adm-bg and --adm-ink (asserted by reading the stylesheet)

tasks.title: Convert T to var(--adm-*) references and slim themeStyle
acceptance_criteria: Every color key of T (bg, bgDeep, card, cardAlt, ink, inkSoft, inkFaint, line, lineStrong, accent, cool, inputBg) is a var(--adm-*) reference per the spec mapping.
Font keys (serif, mono, sans) remain literal font-family strings.
themeStyle no longer sets any --adm-* variable inline; it keeps background: var(--adm-bg), color: var(--adm-ink), fontFamily only.
The exported shape (T keys, themeStyle, TYPES, TYPE_LABEL) is unchanged so no consumer breaks.
tests: T.card resolves to a var(--adm-card) reference and T retains all original keys
themeStyle does not contain any --adm-* property (moved to CSS) and still sets background/color

tasks.title: Theme-aware admin weather icons (LIGHT/DARK palettes)
acceptance_criteria: WeatherIcon selects a LIGHT or DARK palette via useResolvedTheme() from ../theme/ThemeProvider (same pattern as src/components/WeatherIcon.jsx).
LIGHT palette fill/line values are byte-identical to the current hard-coded ones (light mode pixel-identical).
DARK palette reuses the already-approved values from src/components/WeatherIcon.jsx (lifted outlines/fills so glyphs read on the dark card).
The SVG geometry and all render branches are unchanged.
tests: admin WeatherIcon selects a brighter DARK stroke under a dark ThemeProvider vs light
an unknown weather type renders nothing

tasks.title: Place ThemeToggle in the admin header
acceptance_criteria: ThemeToggle is rendered in the admin header actions cluster (alongside SaveBar / logout).
The header layout (mobile back button, marginLeft:auto actions group, save + logout) stays intact on desktop and the <=720px breakpoint.
tests: AdminPage renders a theme toggle button in the admin header
